source_strategy: Individually CC-licensed exact-source determination GBIF media and actual JPEG bytes; no parent-taxon photos and no near duplicates. Existing original photos and credits preserved. Joey Santore CC BY-NC and user-owned Glass Root Garden sources remain available in separate photo pools for licensed manual selection.
rules: Check current manifest, claims, inbox, actual one-image gallery before modification
Skip a card if another batch already enriched it
Keep all taxonomic and native-range decisions intact
Do not invent verified anatomical role, morphology arrow or photo quality
Preserve actual license and creator, including CC BY-NC restrictions
No new recurring automation; this is a user-requested once-only GitHub Action
